evidence.reason: The dependency scan already treats stop/restart propagation as in scope: it matches PartOf= and Conflicts=, and comment lines 104-108 say co-installed units that reference crq units must be found. StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo= are dependency directives in the same class: a foreign unit with StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service is stopped when the selected crq unit is stopped, directly allowing the fence stop to hit an active co-tenant. Omitting both directives lets such a unit evade discovery, so this is an implementation defect in the existing discovery behavior, not merely a request to enlarge protection scope.
